version.description:
**Make saving a little more rewarding.**

Saving Worlds turns your savings goals into beautiful little worlds that grow as you save.

Saving for a holiday, a new phone, a car, or something you've always wanted? Create your goal, record the money you set aside, and watch your own little world come to life.

**BUILD YOUR OWN WORLD**

Start with an empty island. Every milestone brings something new: trees, paths, flowers, a cozy house, a bridge, and more. The closer you get to your savings goal, the more your world grows.

Reach 100% and complete your island. Your finished world becomes part of your Collection, a little reminder of what you've achieved.

**MAKE SAVING FUN**

Stay motivated with simple savings challenges. Make your first deposit, reach your next milestone, or work toward a weekly target.

No pressure. No penalties. Just small steps toward your goals.

**EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO TRACK YOUR SAVINGS**

• Create and manage your savings goal

• Record deposits and withdrawals

• Track your progress and remaining amount

• Set an optional deadline

• See how much you need to save each week or month

• Review and edit your savings history

• Pause, complete, or reopen your goal

• Get an optional weekly reminder

• Keep your completed worlds in your Collection

**UNLOCK MORE WITH SAVING WORLDS PRO**

Want to build more than one world?

Unlock Saving Worlds Pro with a one-time purchase and enjoy:

• Unlimited savings goals

• The beautiful Garden world

• Switch between Island and Garden themes

• Savings statistics and progress charts

No subscriptions. No ads.

**YOUR SAVINGS, YOUR CONTROL**

No account required. No bank connections. Your savings records stay on your iPhone, and the app works offline.

Saving Worlds doesn't hold or transfer real money. You simply record what you've saved in real life.

Start with one goal. Build your first world. Make every little saving count.
